svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — Warehouse view, route map of round 1
svg.desc: Concept 10 Coupon Book. Top-down layout of all 9 aisles (19 sections x 4 levels x 3 positions) showing occupied and empty locations, movement class by fill weight, best-location zones with a B tab, and every move of round 1 drawn as a numbered route arc with a flight-code label. A coupon stub lists the legs.
svg.text: created by Justas · last edited by Justas
Planning copy of Spring re-slot 2026 · route map of round 1 · data as of 2026-09-30
Each aisle: 19 sections × 4 levels (level 1 is the bottom row) × 3 positions; blank = not in the Locations file. A cell shows the highest movement class it stores.
Arcs run in move-list order (Walk Path of the from-location). Arc length is not a walking distance; the tool knows no distances or shelf sizes.
Aisle D · level 1 · occupied · not a best location
1 outdated · 1 kept in place · 9 no space
